name: Dancing Herald

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Endless Footwork
traits.summary: At Speed 0, attacks against it have Advantage; at the start of its turn at Speed 0 it takes 20 Necrotic.
traits.text: While the herald's Speed is 0, attack rolls against it have Advantage. If its Speed is 0 at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Perfect Grace
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.
traits.text: The herald provokes no Opportunity Attack when it leaves an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Banner Pole attacks; one can be Lethal Jape.
actions.text: The herald makes three Banner Pole attacks. It can replace one of them with a use of Lethal Jape.

actions.name: Banner Pole

params.to: any other unoccupied space within the pole's reach

actions.summary: +10 (Advantage if the target's Speed is 0), reach 10 ft, 1d10+6 Slashing plus 3d8 Thunder; moves a Large or smaller target to another free space within its reach.
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, with Advantage if the target's Speed is 0; reach 10 feet. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Thunder damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the herald can move it to any other unoccupied space within the Banner Pole's reach.

actions.name: Lethal Jape
actions.summary: DC 15 Wis save, one creature within 60 ft: 7d6 Psychic (half on a success) and on a failure Speed 0 until the end of its next turn.
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, a creature the herald can see within 60 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Psychic damage, and the target's Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. Success: half damage only.

reactions.name: Wave the Banner
reactions.trigger: An ally within 60 feet misses with an attack roll or fails a saving throw.
reactions.summary: When an ally within 60 ft misses an attack or fails a save, that ally rerolls the d20 and must use the new roll.
reactions.text: Trigger: an ally of the herald within 60 feet misses with an attack roll or fails a saving throw. Response: the ally can reroll the d20 and must use the new roll.

summary: One of Chuckles's dancing Heralds in the finale: a Herald of Fools with 30 Hit Points and no Multiattack.
